summary.text: Jack Holzman is the Democratic candidate for the Wisconsin State Assembly, District 59, in the November 3, 2026 general election, where he faces Republican Bradley Petersen in a race with no incumbent.
He was also the Democratic nominee for the same seat in 2024.

paragraphs.text: Jack Holzman advanced from the August 13, 2024 Democratic primary for Assembly District 59 and lost the November 5, 2024 general election to incumbent Republican Robert Brooks, 75.7 percent to 24.2 percent.
He advanced from the August 11, 2026 Democratic primary for the seat, which has no incumbent this year.
